what: From when the top edge of the section (Footer) touches the bottom of the screen until its bottom edge touches the bottom of the screen, two big wordmark halves attached at the bottom spread apart, left by -51% and right by +50% (power1.out) — during the same time the center plate rises from 100% below and transparent (2/5 of the length, .5/5 late, straight) and the pattern behind floats up from -2vw to -25.5vw

options.rise: End point where the back pattern rises (vw), default 25.5

from.where: shared.js footer() — original Footer.footerScroll: spacer top bottom→bottom bottom scrub, wordmark xPercent 0→-51·0→50 (5, power1.out), panel yPercent 100·hidden→0 (2, linear, .5), big B y -2vw→-25.5vw
